title: 2:20–2:45 · One gateway for every SerpApi call
lede: Voiceover: “Every SerpApi call goes through one gateway: it refuses anything that looks like personal data, caches results, and holds a monthly budget per feature. The same gateway serves the nightly card refresh, which re-checks three cards a night on their bank's own site, so facts follow the bank's current page. Today: 26 live searches and 67 answered from cache.”
